brief: A soldering station for my bench: a holder for the iron while it is switched on and hot, plus two bins for solder and spare tips.

requirements.evidence: cover:1,0,0;full;top with 2x hex-acc-saddle-one cradles (accessory:0#1,0#0 etc) on piece:1,0,0;full; screwdriver prop staged as iron shaft resting across. No dedicated iron-holder part exists in catalog; shape helps cradle an iron but heat/material safety unverified.

finish.summary: 3-cell station: iron cradle cell (cover + 2 pipe-saddle cradles staging an iron) plus half-depth solder bin and 2-compartment tips bin. check_build clear, capped and locked. Heat safety unmet - material unknown.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
